description_html:
<section aria-labelledby="courseDescription">
    Training in the elements of Japanese communication (speaking and writing) and comprehension (listening and reading) within a variety of cultural contexts.

Three hours of applied class work and one hour of foreign language lab per week is required.

Note: Advanced placement and credit by examination are available to students who have previously studied Japanese.

    
</section>
